# Baseline characteristics by study and intervention arm

Maternal, infant, and household characteristics by randomized arm, at each trial's first postnatal milk-collection visit (for MISAME-III, the 276 of 290 dyads with a 14–21-day sample). A variable a trial did not collect is left out of its table.

```{r baseline-setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(table1)

raw_path <- here::here("data/merged_analysis_datasets.RDS")
have_baseline <- file.exists(raw_path)
if (!have_baseline) {
  cat("*The baseline data file (`data/merged_analysis_datasets.RDS`) is not present in this build. Rerun the analysis code (see README) to generate it.*\n\n")
}
raw_df <- if (have_baseline) readRDS(raw_path) else NULL

baseline_labels <- c(
  sex = "Infant sex", mage = "Maternal age (years)", meducyrs = "Maternal education (years)",
  mbmi = "Maternal BMI (kg/m²)", mmuaccm = "Maternal MUAC (cm)", mhtcm = "Maternal height (cm)",
  parity = "Parity", nperson = "Household size (persons)", nrooms = "Rooms in household",
  imp_water_src = "Water source", impfloor = "Improved flooring", cookplac = "Separate cooking space",
  dvseason = "Season of delivery", dlvloc = "Delivery location",
  hhwealth = "Household wealth index", hhfoodsecure = "Household food security")

## Continuous rows as table1 prints them, but with a floating-point mean of a
## standardized index (e.g. 1e-16) shown as 0.
render_cont <- function(x, ...) {
  s <- table1::stats.default(x)
  ms <- zapsmall(c(s$MEAN, s$SD)); s$MEAN <- ms[1]; s$SD <- ms[2]
  s <- table1::stats.apply.rounding(s, digits = 3)
  c("", "Mean (SD)" = sprintf("%s (%s)", s$MEAN, s$SD),
    "Median [Min, Max]" = sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", s$MEDIAN, s$MIN, s$MAX))
}

## One table per trial. Codes are spelled out, and labels are set after
## droplevels(), which strips them from factors.
baseline_table <- function(study, first_visit, omit = character()) {
  d <- raw_df[raw_df$studyid == study & raw_df$visit == first_visit, , drop = FALSE]
  d$impfloor <- factor(c("0" = "No", "1" = "Yes")[as.character(d$impfloor)], levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ck <- as.character(d$cookplac)
  ck[ck %in% "Separate space for cooking"] <- "Yes"
  ck[!ck %in% c("No", "Yes")] <- NA
  d$cookplac <- factor(ck, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  d <- droplevels(d)
  vars <- setdiff(intersect(names(baseline_labels), names(d)), omit)
  ## Not collected: all missing, or, for a number, a constant placeholder (food
  ## security is 0 throughout where a trial did not measure it).
  vars <- vars[vapply(vars, function(v) {
    x <- stats::na.omit(d[[v]])
    if (is.numeric(x)) length(unique(x)) > 1 else length(x) > 0
  }, logical(1))]
  for (v in vars) table1::label(d[[v]]) <- baseline_labels[[v]]
  table1::table1(stats::as.formula(paste("~", paste(vars, collapse = " + "), "| arm")),
                 data = d, render.continuous = render_cont)
}
```

## MISAME-III (Burkina Faso)

```{r baseline-misame, echo=FALSE}
if (have_baseline) baseline_table("MISAME-3", 1, omit = "mhtcm")
```

## Mumta-LW (Pakistan)

```{r baseline-mumta, echo=FALSE}
if (have_baseline) baseline_table("VITAL-Lactation", 40)
```

## ELICIT (Tanzania)

```{r baseline-elicit, echo=FALSE}
if (have_baseline) baseline_table("ELICIT", 1)
```
